note: What the base product's source zip, org.niord.web:niord-fe-src, holds: a path relative to fe/ that an include glob matches and no exclude glob does, and catalog.json at the root. The applications' sources and public assets (the base product's tree holds no country overlay; its own test:guards keeps it so), the shared folders, the workspace files the kit generates from, the base tokens, the en pack, the administration app's end-to-end suite with its login fixtures and the Playwright configuration (a country's generated e2e script runs its own specs with them, now that they name no country's test environment; the kit's own tests hold them to that), of scripts/ only the public site's checks a country calls with parameters, the absolute-URL rule's allow-list and glob.mjs (the base product's own copy of the glob matcher, which build-urls-check.mjs imports), and eslint-shared.cjs, the lint lists eslint.config.js takes. The kit is its own package, org.niord:niord-country-kit (kit-include.json), and nothing of it is in this zip. No file outside the kit imports the kit, and verify checks it. Never another pack, fe/docs/, another scripts/ file, an AGENTS.md or a CLAUDE.md, a README under ui-apps/ or a backlog. Loosened when the repositories go public (fe-country-split-plan §4.11 rule 6).
